card.name: Verbs and links before evaluative judgments
card.fires_on: Small linking words (be, was, is, never, a, with) right before an evaluative word such as satisfying, fatal, bad, incompatible or grammatical. It shows up in argumentative prose, mostly general web text.

modes.label: Copula before a verdict
modes.description: A form of be sits just before an adjective that judges something.

modes.label: Negator or article before a judgment
modes.description: Words like never or a come just before a good/bad style evaluation.
modes.example: Opponents argue that pain is<< never>> a good default way in which to train
